scope: Read-only synthesis + spec for the closure rungs that come AFTER the acceptance goal ('visible menu + successful in-game spawn'). Prepares three forward documents: the post-spawn stability gate, the complete-acceptance artifact record, and the restore path (teardown or leave-installed). No console contact, no network commands, no nested subagents; writes confined to outputs/2026-10-04-zcode-team/worker-post-spawn-closure-prep/.

claims: STABILITY-GATE.md defines post-spawn stability criteria (time-resident thresholds, repeated spawn attempts, save/load cycles, observer growth-record corroboration, clean exit) as closure rungs SG-A..SG-E that never gate and never advance the CP/rung ladder, plus a crash-report procedure that combines the aligned-entry log (D1) with the probes' persist-before-mutate (map-persist) discipline.

ACCEPTANCE-RECORD.md is the artifact manifest of a COMPLETE acceptance: per-track tables (runtime CP0-CP7 + rungs 1-5, DLL 7/8-family, installer E2E, app, staging receipts) naming every file, its producing step, and its archive location under the canonical run-dir layout runs/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<flow>/, with an explicit incompleteness-is-honest rule.

RESTORE-PATH.md documents both end-states: ordered full teardown (ini-first rollback to the .bak/pre-image or stock empty-config, then file removal, settings v2 restore or root removal, slot restore to r11-era identities or stock) AND the leave-installed safety case (fail-open proven across launches L1-L8; activation-root isolation under /data/modbridge/**; single-byte kill switch; re-validation triggers).

Every threshold, checklist, and end-state in the three docs is marked PROPOSAL where it has never been console-executed; all byte identities, paths, and laws cited are traced to the listed on-disk sources; no completion, parity, or >8-quality claim is made.
out_of_scope: Executing any curl/ftp/python command against the console (ps5-host-not-configured.invalid)
Modifying ploader.ini, the activation root, the payload slot, or any staged file
Advancing or certifying any CP checkpoint or rung from host evidence
Re-running or replaying any other worker's verifier, probe, or failed job
Building a new observer/probe revision (only the discipline for future revisions is specified)
honesty_notes: The stability gate, acceptance record, and restore path are forward-looking contracts: nothing in them has run on the console, and the acceptance goal itself (visible menu + successful spawn) is still [TARGET] per the eve-state.
